scope: Direct frozen VLM graded pair judgments and test-candidate graphs; no external API, scorer fitting, calibration, prompt change, threshold/K/t selection, new human labels, or frozen-output changes.

definitions.identity: strict_parse(response_text).contract_valid and structured same_visual_entity == yes; parse, runtime or consistency failure -> false, counted separately. Field is the existing yes/no/uncertain enum; do not equate it with duplicate.
definitions.mismatch: Stored canonical parsed.decision == mismatch; newly run rows use unchanged strict_parse. Preserve historical response_text and canonical decisions.
definitions.reuse: Use exact endpoint identities and original orientation. Read original STAGE_E_CLUSTERS_RUN final raw verdict sources and ACTIONS_RUN supplements referenced by canonical actions; never rerun existing U_new judgments. Canonicalize unordered endpoint keys; duplicate/foreign/unresolved identities stop. Reuse new A judgments in B if identities overlap; report union and overlap explicitly.
definitions.beta: COMBINED_ACTIONS_RUN fusion field, fallback FLAG_REP_RUN fusion for record IDs absent from COMBINED_ACTIONS_RUN; frozen t=0.05960534898891063; min(endpoint beta) < t.
definitions.same_entity_positive: L0/L2/L3; exclude M from visual truth. MV product identity evaluated separately.
definitions.failures: Terminal invalid outputs are false identity and uncertain final action. No automatic retries or response repair.

A.A2: Per relation: count VLM identity, LR direct edges (candidate and calibrated>=2/3, absent candidate=false), frozen global LR K5 co-membership; five final decisions. P/R/F1 on 9494 visually known test pairs and separately 5968 MV pairs.
A.A3: Full labeled mismatch: positive 543 M, negative 8701 same-entity pairs. Compare VLM, beta rule, VLM OR beta. Repeat on frozen global K5 co-member subset (372 M,8696 same). TP/FP/FN/P/R/F1; no threshold selection.

B.nodes: All test records, including isolated and M path nodes. Filter candidate endpoints to test before construction. Evaluate induced co-membership on 5998 non-M records only.
B.vlm_cc: VLM identity edges; unlimited connected components.
B.vlm_k5: Same edges; cap component size5; order clip_image_score descending, low endpoint ID ascending, high endpoint ID ascending.
B.vl_cc: LR calibrated>=2/3 on the same test-candidate universe; unlimited components.
B.vl_k5: Same LR edges; cap5; calibrated descending, raw descending, low/high endpoint ID ascending.
B.evaluation: GRAPH_SURFACES_RUN pairwise contingency counts; 5998 records,17985003 unordered pairs,8701 true same pairs. TP/FP/FN/F1,cluster count,max cluster,|U|; report full test graph structure separately from non-M evaluation projection.
B.disagreement: Count VLM-only and LR-only edges separately, mutually exclusive endpoint classes: same non-M visual group; L1 same caption different image; HN same superclass different product; other different-group. M endpoints separately counted to avoid inventing known visual truth.
B.progress: Write durable progress every10000 new B pairs.

gates.policy: Independently calculate; any discrepancy stops and is reported without changing inputs, definitions or supplied budgets.

inference.PAIR_PILOT_RUN_gate: Original400 sample order/orientation, single-pair submissions and max_num_seqs4 as frozen STAGE_E_CLUSTERS_RUN phase1a; main new inference uses16.

execution_order: Commit protocol only: docs(vlm_direct): freeze direct VLM protocol
Wait behind VERBATIM_EXPORT_RUN for gpu.lock; inspect nvidia-smi before model load
PAIR_PILOT_RUN gate3 under GPU lock; stop on failure
A: project runtime after first1000 new pairs; stop if A+B estimated GPU time>9h

coordination.GPU: flock gpu.lock; imports/model/load/worker lifetime entirely locked; no preemption. VERBATIM_EXPORT_RUN has priority.
coordination.timing: Separate lock wait, model load, inference, GPU session wall time and seconds per pair; forecast on first1000 new A pairs, use actual union of remaining requests; threshold9h. Supplied planning estimate57700 pairs at0.437s~7h is not an observation.

tests: tests/test_vlm_direct.py:identity/failure handling,exact reuse/new union,clip score ordering and K5 cap,pairwise conservation
validation.provenance: Named paths,commits,counts and sizes; no new hashes. Tests run with vl-dedup/bin/python -I -m pytest.
